desc_prompt:
📉 THE REPO (link — also pinned in comments): https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify

The whole install:
uv tool install graphifyy
graphify install
then type /graphify . in Claude Code

Free, Apache-2.0, runs on-device. Code parsing uses tree-sitter — zero LLM credits to build the graph. Token-savings figures you may see online (like "71.5x") are community-reported, not our benchmark. Not affiliated with Graphify Labs or Anthropic.
